proposal.reason: Primary change is communicator configuration lifecycle: new config fields are validated/defaulted, env-overridable, stored on comm state, and synchronized across ranks. device-topology is additionally needed because P2P per-peer channel computation now applies explicit nChannelsPerNetPeer/maxP2pPeers policy and peer-budget tuning in topology path/channel logic. enqueue is additionally needed because graphUsageMode substantively changes strong-stream graph/uncaptured acquire-release behavior and P2P scheduling caps during plan construction.
